Reachable keeps the content of a declarative shadow root

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{\"hidden_content\":\"Reachable\"}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<div><template shadowrootmode=\"open\"><p>shadow body</p></template><span>light body</span></div>", options: _options)
debugPrint(result.content as Any)
```
